findings.summary: Existing tag-scope EXISTS uses fixed alias ktr. An original chunks alias ktr can shadow the correlated outer alias, turning ktr.knowledge_id = ktr.knowledge_id into an inner tautology and allowing an untagged chunk in the same authorized tenant/KB.
